analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($380.82) vs SMA5/20/50 ($369.91/$368.91/$367.88) — Short/mid-term trend above, confirming entry into strong zone.
· 10.64% above SMA100/200 ($354.65/$344.19) — Maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (98.7%) + Current price near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (47.5→66.3) + Exited oversold, settled in neutral zone, confirmed upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.7717→0.9166) + Continued improvement, signal of expanding strength post-golden cross.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near Upper Band $377.34) + Broke upper band, expanding bullish zone.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($365.31) + Basis (Moving average based, Pivot S1 $366.77).
· Swing Resistance ($388.31) + Potential to break 52-week high upon breach.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Recovering Higher Low) + Signal of strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.00x) + Normal level, maintaining confidence in movement.
· Current Zone Diagnosis (Uptrend) + Expect further upside on breaking 52-week high, condition to switch to wait-and-see upon breaking $365.31 support.
